newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Interstate Bakeries EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Interstate Bakeries EPS view up.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst John McMillin said Wednesday he raised his earnings estimates for Interstate Bakeries Corp for fiscal 1997 to $2.40 a share from $2.30 and for fiscal 1998 to $2.85 from $2.75.
-- McMillin said he also reiterated his buy recommendation on the stock.

-- Earlier, Interstate reported stronger than expected earnings for the third quarter ended March 8 of $0.59 a share, up from $0.11 a year ago. In February, Interstate executives said they were comfortable with earnings estimates of $0.35 to $0.40 a share for the quarter.
-- McMillin said Interstate's results reflect cost savings and improvements in its product mix.

-- In its earnings statement, Interstate said it exceeded expectations through the first three quarters of its fiscal year. For the first nine months of the year, Interstate earned $1.78 a share, up from $0.47 a year ago.
-- The company added, however, that while it is on track for a strong fourth quarter, it does not expect the increases to be of the magnitude of the prior three quarters.
